channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: Natasha Rothwell, Tessa Thompson and Kumail Nanjiani Among Stars Protesting ICE at 2026 Spirit Awards
item.description: While some celebrities wore "ICE Out" pins at the awards ceremony on Sunday, 'The White Lotus' alum Rothwell also said "F*** ICE" before presenting her award.

item.title: Spirit Awards: Clint Bentley Says ‘Train Dreams’ Is About “All the Small Lives That Keep the World Going”
item.description: The Netflix film won best feature at the awards ceremony on Sunday, as well as best director and best cinematography.

item.title: Robby Hoffman Clears Up Claim That Spirit Awards Grant Recipients Can “Spend the Money How You Want”: “I Didn’t Read the Script”
item.description: During her second presenting appearance at the ceremony, the 'Hacks' star joked that "the reason I'm back is they told me you're actually not allowed to use the money however you see fit on the last grant."

item.title: Savannah Guthrie Posts New Message About Mom Nancy’s Disappearance: “We Still Have Hope”
item.description: Meanwhile, authorities said Sunday that a glove found near Nancy's house appears to match those worn by a person seen outside her front door the night she vanished.

item.title: Spirit Awards Snubs: Top Nominees ‘Peter Hujar’s Day,’ ‘One of Them Days,’ ‘Twinless’ Shut Out
item.description: On the TV side, both 'Forever' and 'Mr Loverman' went into the ceremony with four nominations, the same as 'Adolescence,' which swept its categories, but went home empty-handed.

item.title: ‘A Prayer for the Dying’ Review: Johnny Flynn and John C. Reilly Face a Test of Moral Fiber in a Dazzling Debut
item.description: Set in 1870 Wisconsin, Dara Van Dusen's Berlin-bowing first feature is a revisionist Western based on Stewart O'Nan's novella.
